clips.text: The present preliminary treatment plant looks insignificant beside the immense building operations that are going on near it incidental to the con struction of a new filtration plant, pumping station and power plant.

He savs that all the major fea tures of the project are practically completed, and that the remaining Items, with the exception of the nec -1 essary repair of the old tunnel to the McMillan filtration plant and tests of various sections of the system, will be completed during the next fiscal year.

The plan of the Citizens’ Association contemplates cutting away the north east corner of the Soldiers’ Home grounds to give westbound traffic a less abrupt turn and to cut off a similar section of McMillan Park, on the southwest corner, to improve the curve for traffic going east or turn ing into Michigan avenue.
Langdon School will receive the Bloomingdale division trophy for the third consecutive year, which means that it becomes part of the perma nent trophy display at that school.

note: Clips are machine-read text (OCR) from scanned Evening Star pages on the Library of Congress's Chronicling America, lightly cleaned (line-break hyphens rejoined, stray symbols removed); misspellings are the scanner's. Newspapers this old are public domain. Each clip links to its page at loc.gov. Clips that mention race, covenants, deed restrictions or slurs are skipped automatically (keyword list: race, races, racial, colored, coloured, negro, negroes, white only, whites only, for whites, white people, white persons, white residents, caucasian, segregation, segregated, covenant, covenants, restricted, restriction, restrictions, plus a list of slurs), because they need an editor's context; legal notices and lists of private individuals are skipped too.
